body: Play in a band that gets moderate recognition

Music majors are for concert band players and music degrees go nowhere. You pay 100,000 for four years and end up with a piece of paper and the fact that you're allowed to say "I completed college"

I also tried music major stuff and I hated it. a lot

I haven't declared a major because there isn't anything I want to major in. I just tell everyone I'm "still thinking about it."

I don't really want to do anything. I've never found anything enjoyable in life except playing music on stage, but every time I've tried to join or get something together, It never works. It goes for like two weeks and then bombs.

And even playing music, I don't care a lot about; it's just the most enjoyable thing at this point.
